Algebra 1 · Unit 5: Systems of Equations

Substitution

Solve a system by replacing one variable with an expression from the other equation.

What you’ll learn

  • Solve a system by substitution
  • Choose which variable to substitute
  • Check a solution in both equations

Learning activities

Interactive lab · from Algebra 1: Graphing Systems

Uplift

The Ultimate Bike Park Operations Challenge: run a fictional mountain bike destination. Compare shuttle plans on a live pricing graph, stock the rental fleet by substitution, price workshop parts by elimination, then mix trail dirt, race two trail crews and solve break-even problems with whichever method fits.

Level
Beginner to Advanced
Time
40-55 min
  • 4 stages
  • Operations HQ
  • Live pricing graph
  • Substitution and elimination workbenches
  • Dirt mixing station
  • Crew progress simulator
  • Mountain Operations Certification (10)
  • Opening Day Command Center

Practices here: Solve a system by substitution; Choose which variable to substitute; Check a solution in both equations

Opens at: Stage 2: Build the Rental Fleet · or start from the beginning
